name: repeated_lines_abab
why: §8: 'Opakované řádky určuje jejich pozice v původní revizi.' base a,b,a,b,a -> target a,b,a has THREE shortest scripts: delete lines {2,3}, {3,4} or {4,5}. The deterministic answer is {4,5}. Myers' greedy phase extends the diagonal as far as it can before spending an edit, so it matches base lines 1,2,3 against the entire target first and the frontier is already at (3,3); the only way on to (5,3) is two delete moves, which merge into a single span. The rule to remember: the EARLIEST occurrences in the base are kept.
